$comment: S16's board, with two competing proposals branched from its current variant. Each adds Flask's test client. In `Client at the entry` it calls WSGI entry, as any WSGI server does, so Flask app gains a caller and no entry point: one entry point, three hidden parts, two callers, two outgoing relationships, no pass-through entry point. In `Client at dispatch` it calls Dispatch, which then becomes an entry point that sends one call on, of the kind it receives: two entry points, two hidden parts, two callers, two outgoing relationships, one pass-through entry point. The current variant has one entry point, three hidden parts, one caller, two outgoing relationships and no pass-through entry point.
